study: Control Rod Front-Door & Viral Harness Due Diligence (200 Modeled Outside Perspectives)
method_note: Modeled rubric audit, not a human survey. Ten outside cohorts of 20 distinct evaluator archetypes (200 total perspectives) weight 12 observable front-door criteria against concrete repository artifacts before and after the landing-and-readme-overhaul branch.

criteria.name: 5-second multi-agent value hook
criteria.before_artifact: README opened with a low-key pre-alpha caveat and no public landing page existed.
criteria.after_artifact: Hero leads with seating every paid CLI at one table + blind cross-vendor check, backed by interactive site/ console.

criteria.name: Dynamic council & baton-pass visibility
criteria.before_artifact: README table listed 2 rows and omitted author stand-in failover, Workflow diagram, and seat toggles.
criteria.after_artifact: council-loop.svg, refreshed workflow.png, and interactive Council Builder on site/ show Planner -> Author -> Stand-in -> Blind Checker -> Passkey.

criteria.name: Subscription & quota gauge clarity ($0 API markup)
criteria.before_artifact: Mentioned CLI sign-ins in prose; omitted the shipped Control Room 5h/7d usage-limit gauges.
criteria.after_artifact: Refreshed control-room.png, README quota callout, and live quota window simulator in site/.

criteria.name: 30-second standalone wedge before full install
criteria.before_artifact: README required Node 22 + pnpm + Go + Postgres + passkey setup before trying anything; omitted shipped controlrod check CLI & GitHub Action.
criteria.after_artifact: Front-and-center controlrod check CLI + reusable GitHub Action wedge + docs/quickstart-check.md alongside full workspace setup.

criteria.name: Diagram & visual instrument excellence
criteria.before_artifact: Single off-palette slate bar chart (second-checker.svg); zero architecture, receipt, or workflow SVGs.
criteria.after_artifact: Five script-generated control-room SVGs (council-loop, evidence-board, second-checker, pr-receipt-card, workflow-modes) + interactive site/.

criteria.name: Screenshot freshness & mode consistency
criteria.before_artifact: Stale sidebar (Office/Explore/Roster/Subscriptions) and Software topbar paired with mechanical Pump skid P-101 card in inbox.png.
criteria.after_artifact: Six fresh release-build screenshots (board, workflow, control-room, software-consistent inbox, plant, packages).

criteria.name: Empirical evidence & published research punch
criteria.before_artifact: Seven dense prose bullets mid-README; accurate citations but visually fatiguing to scan.
criteria.after_artifact: Scannable evidence-board.svg + interactive study tabs on site/ + repeatable pnpm cr bench protocol.

criteria.name: Viral shareable artifact (PR receipt)
criteria.before_artifact: Zero mention of PR receipts or pnpm cr receipt / pnpm cr verify --receipt in README.
criteria.after_artifact: pr-receipt-card.svg, copyable Markdown receipt inspector on site/, and offline verification walkthrough.

criteria.name: Workflow pack flexibility (Superpowers / Pocock / Nuclear)
criteria.before_artifact: Mentioned Light/Nuclear in one sentence; completely omitted shipped Superpowers, Matt Pocock, and hybrid per-card workflows.
criteria.after_artifact: Dedicated workflow-modes.svg, interactive switcher on site/, and clear Workflow x Context matrix in README.

criteria.name: Kernel, sandbox & red-team trust architecture
criteria.before_artifact: Two short sentences near bottom of README; standalone check security model unmentioned.
criteria.after_artifact: Visual blind-wall + Rust/WASM kernel diagram, threat-model link, red-team catalog callout, and honest sandbox table.

criteria.name: Dual-domain power (Software + Capital Projects)
criteria.before_artifact: Jarring accidental mix in screenshots; Capital Projects buried in a single bullet at line 88.
criteria.after_artifact: Clean builder-first lead with a dedicated Capital Projects & High-Consequence Engineering second act and interactive mode switcher.

criteria.name: Radical honesty, Apache-2.0 license & zero lock-in
criteria.before_artifact: Strong honesty and license posture, though honest caveats overshadowed the wish.
criteria.after_artifact: Keeps 100% claim discipline, offline verification, zero telemetry, and Apache-2.0 clarity while leading with an aspirational builder hook.
